title: Evaluation of open restriction is identity on sections
statement: Let C be a category with object universe c and morphism universe v, J a Grothendieck topology, and C essentially small in max c v r. Let B_n be commutative ring sheaves in that universe with transitions tau_n : B_(n+1) to B_n. For the actual system model [def-coef-semilinear-system-models] and openRestriction of [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus], each U in C and n in the natural numbers admits an isomorphism from openRestriction followed by level n evaluation to level n evaluation followed by restriction to Over U. On every system N and object W of Over U its component is the identity on the underlying section carrier N(n,W.left), with heterogeneous equality accounting for the restricted scalar structures.

proof.text: Both composite ring maps are equality transports. Functoriality and transitivity of equality transport identify them. Compose the two pushforwardComp isomorphisms with pushforwardCongr of this equality; every component is identity on sections.

theorem openRestrictionEvaluationSections (U : C) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ δ : openRestriction.{c, v, r} J B τ U ⋙
      evaluation.{max c v, v, max c v r} (J.over U)
        (openRings.{c, v, r} J B U) (openTransitions.{c, v, r} J B τ U) n ≅
      evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n ⋙
        SheafOfModules.localizedSystemRestriction.{c, v, r} (B n) U,
      ∀ (N : Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) (W : Over U)
        (x : ((openRestriction.{c,v,r} J B τ U ⋙
          evaluation.{max c v, v, max c v r} (J.over U)
            (openRings.{c,v,r} J B U) (openTransitions.{c,v,r} J B τ U) n).obj N).val.obj
          (op W)),
        HEq ((δ.hom.app N).val.app (op W) x) x
